title: lycium undulatum
intro: Lycium undulatum, commonly known as California box or California desert box, is a species of flowering plant in the nightshade family, native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been used for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, helping to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Lycium undulatum include its ability to stimulate immune function, protect against oxidative stress, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
